items.name: utility-droid
items.title: Utility droid
items.description: A configurable cylindrical utility droid with three dome shapes, two chassis layouts, rotating sensors, and deployable tools. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: orb-droid
items.title: Orb droid
items.description: A rolling spherical companion with an independently stabilized head, segmented shell, pointer-tracking eye, and configurable antennas. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: bellows-droid
items.title: Bellows droid
items.description: A soft-shell pneumatic pod whose pleated dome inflates and settles under a volume-conserving profile, carrying its lens pods and vent with it. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: protocol-droid
items.title: Protocol droid
items.description: An articulate humanoid translator with formal, conversational, and cautious poses, four gestures, and optional exposed wiring. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: security-droid
items.title: Security droid
items.description: A tall angular security humanoid with controlled guard and patrol poses, pointer-tracking optics, and an alert state. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: medical-droid
items.title: Medical droid
items.description: A modular clinical assistant with a diagnostic display, controlled head angle, and five interchangeable instrument ends. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: infantry-droid
items.title: Infantry droid
items.description: A mechanical infantry unit with light and heavy frames, four controlled poses, and interchangeable utility equipment. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: probe-droid
items.title: Probe droid
items.description: A hovering survey probe with a steerable sensor mast, controlled altitude, active scan cone, and three to six appendages. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: courier-droid
items.title: Courier droid
items.description: A compact floor-running courier with controlled heading, front-wheel steering, tread travel, antenna options, and cargo modules. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: casing-droid
items.title: Casing droid
items.description: An armoured conical casing unit with a hemisphere skirt, rotating dome, elevating eyestalk, swappable manipulator, and emitter rod. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: astromech-droid
items.title: Astromech droid
items.description: A barrel repair unit with tripod and bipod ride heights, a rotating dome and radar eye, an opening service panel, a rising periscope, and a holographic projection cone. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: attendant-droid
items.title: Attendant droid
items.description: A plated humanoid attendant with a fixed faceplate and vocoder grille, four etiquette poses, and plating levels that strip back to the exposed loom. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: cyber-trooper
items.title: Cyber trooper
items.description: A converted armoured humanoid with a blank slab head, optional side handles, three chest units, a bounded power meter, and four controlled poses. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: robot-hound
items.title: Robot hound
items.description: A boxy companion tracker on a concealed drive: a flared wedge chassis with a head carried out on a concertina neck, splayed ear dishes, a telescoping probe off the tail, and one attention number that runs all of it. Four camera angles, and a drag to bring its head up.

items.name: guide-droid
items.title: Guide droid
items.description: A rotor-lifted visitor guide: a shell body hanging under a spinning rotor, hands and feet carried on coil springs that stretch with hover height, ring optics that track the pointer, and a speaker grille that lights as it talks. Fly it by hand from any of four camera angles.

items.name: custodian-droid
items.title: Custodian droid
items.description: A floating armoured custodian: a rounded casing whose armour segments ride radial rails and bloom into a corona around a lit chassis, with a deep-set gimballed optic behind a three-arm bracket cage and a ring of voice cells. Work the shell by hand from any of four camera angles.

items.name: sentinel-console
items.title: Sentinel console
items.description: A bulkhead-mounted watch station: an identity strip, a gimballed optic behind a solved iris diaphragm that stops down to a pinhole, and a voice grille that lights as it speaks. Work the iris by hand from any of four camera angles.

items.name: pylon-droid
items.title: Pylon droid
items.description: A deployable survey pylon: a sharp triangular plate that folds its legs, its aft strut and its mast inside its own outline, then stands itself up on a tripod and lifts its apex cap off a lit core. One deploy number runs all of it, from any of four camera angles.

items.name: monolith-droid
items.title: Monolith droid
items.description: A slab-bodied walker with no limbs: a rectangular column sliced into parallel slabs, each hinged at its own top face, that splay into a braced stance and stride half a cycle apart. Modelled as solids and projected into any of four camera angles.

items.name: micro-duck
items.title: Micro duck
items.description: A desk-scale bipedal duck robot: solved legs, a servo-stack neck, a camera eye that aims where it gazes, and a beak that opens. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: duck-kinematics
items.title: Duck kinematics
items.description: Pure biped pose solver: two rear-breaking legs, a footfall cycle with double support, an S-curve neck chain, and a hinged beak.

items.name: reachy-mini
items.title: Reachy mini
items.description: A companion robot head on a solved six-rod parallel platform, with pointer-tracking eyes, sprung antennas, and a linkage fault lamp. Drawn from any of four camera angles, including its own axonometric.

items.name: stewart-kinematics
items.title: Stewart kinematics
items.description: Closed-form six-degree-of-freedom Stewart platform inverse kinematics with per-leg stroke, travel limits, and a reachability flag.

items.name: robot-quadruped
items.title: Robot quadruped
items.description: A four-legged robot with solved leg geometry, controlled gait phase, stance height, stride, foot lift, and contact indicators. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: quadruped-kinematics
items.title: Quadruped kinematics
items.description: Pure standing, walking, and trotting pose solver with four planar two-link legs and bounded stance controls.

items.name: robot-fish
items.title: Robot fish
items.description: A swimming fish in profile: a tail-weighted body wave, solved hull outline, dorsal and pectoral fins, pointer steering, and a dart on click. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: robot-snake
items.title: Robot snake
items.description: A serpentine crawler in plan view: an even body wave, sidewinding lift with contact marks, a coil, a pointer-tracking head, and a strike on click. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: robot-spider
items.title: Robot spider
items.description: An eight-legged walker in plan view with solved knees, tripod, wave and ripple gaits, a body that turns to face the pointer, and a crouch on click. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: robot-crab
items.title: Robot crab
items.description: A sideways walker in plan view: the hexapod gait turned across the body, two hinged claws, pointer-tracking eyestalks, and a claw snap on click. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: robot-bird
items.title: Robot bird
items.description: A perching flyer in profile: three-link wings carrying fanned feather plates, a beat cycle, a spreading tail, and a takeoff on click. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: robot-dragonfly
items.title: Robot dragonfly
items.description: A four-winged flyer in plan view: fore and hind wings beating half a cycle apart, a solved abdomen that flicks and curls, pointer yaw, and a dart on click. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: robot-bat
items.title: Robot bat
items.description: A membrane flyer in side elevation: a three-link arm carrying four finger struts with the skin drawn through their tips, an inverted roost, and a drop off the beam on click. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: robot-jellyfish
items.title: Robot jellyfish
items.description: A pulsing bell in front elevation: one contraction number narrows, deepens and flares the whole surface of revolution, with a rippling curtain of solved tentacles and a hard contraction on click.

items.name: robot-manta
items.title: Robot manta
items.description: A ray in plan view whose travelling wave runs across the span rather than along the body, with a real roll that foreshortens it, cephalic fins, a whip tail, and a surge on click.

items.name: robot-octopus
items.title: Robot octopus
items.description: A mantle and eight independently solved arms in front elevation, mounted on a ring rather than a line, reaching toward the pointer, with a pumping siphon and a jet on click.

items.name: robot-seahorse
items.title: Robot seahorse
items.description: An upright swimmer in side elevation whose prehensile grip is the spine solver's own steering taken to the stop, with bony rings on every joint and a dorsal fin running far faster than the body.

items.name: robot-ant
items.title: Robot ant
items.description: A six-legged forager in plan view: the shared gait solver at six, three body sections articulated on a short spine, tracking antennae, a cargo module, and working mandibles on click.

items.name: robot-scorpion
items.title: Robot scorpion
items.description: An eight-legged stalker in plan view with a metasoma solved in the sagittal plane, so the arch is a real height rather than a shorter drawing, plus hinged pedipalps and a tail strike on click.

items.name: robot-mantis
items.title: Robot mantis
items.description: A stalker in side elevation whose raptorial forelimbs are a two-link chain solved to a real target — the pointer while it is watched — with solved walking legs and a strike on click.

items.name: robot-frog
items.title: Robot frog
items.description: A jumper in side elevation: solved hind legs driven through crouch, launch, airborne trail and landing by one pair of numbers, with a vocal sac on its own clock and a jump on click.

items.name: robot-cat
items.title: Robot cat
items.description: A quadruped whose body is the mechanism: the shoulder and the hip are the two ends of a solved spine, so arching the back moves both leg roots and four solved legs answer for it. Prowls, sits, arches, and pounces on click.

items.name: robot-dog
items.title: Robot dog
items.description: A quadruped with a floating shoulder: the hip is a spine joint and the shoulder is the far end of a scapula that swings on the ribcage, the neck is a solved chain that puts the nose on the floor, and the tail is solved across the centre plane so the wag runs out of the drawing. Trots, sniffs, sits, points, and barks on click.

items.name: robot-fox
items.title: Robot fox
items.description: A quadruped whose attitude is the mechanism: pitch tips the whole animal about its hip, so the shoulder rides up and the foreleg folds once the floor is past its reach. The brush is an output rather than an input, its carriage derived from the pitch and the rate it is changing at, and the two ears pan independently onto one quarry so their axes converge. Mouses, trots, listens, curls up, and dives on click.

items.name: bear-kinematics
items.title: Bear kinematics
items.description: Plantigrade stance: a rigid heel-to-toe sole placed on the floor with the leg solved to the ankle it produces, the base of support those intervals union into, and the static share of the standing weight at each contact.

items.name: robot-bear
items.title: Robot bear
items.description: The quadruped that stands up. Plantigrade soles make each foot an interval rather than a point, so the four of them union into a base of support with edges; rearing collapses that base to two soles and takes the centre of mass out over it, and the balance rule slides the body back until the margin is positive again. The shoulder hump is an output of what the forelimbs are carrying. Ambles on a lateral sequence, rears, forages, and topples honestly when the balance is off.

items.name: robot-polar-bear
items.title: Robot polar bear
items.description: One body with two ways of holding itself up. Swim is the handover: the plantigrade soles unload as the water takes the weight, the hull settles to a waterline, the hind limbs stop stepping and trail, and the forelimbs paddle on a stroke path the shoulder and elbow are solved to. Long body, long neck, small head — the silhouette does the rest.

items.name: robot-panda
items.title: Robot panda
items.description: The bear that sits down to use its hands. Sitting puts a third contact on the floor — the pelvis, with a span of its own — which is what buys back a base of support once both forepaws have left it. The sixth digit opposes the other five and the pad gap is an output: a fatter stalk rides the thumb further open at the same grip, and both forelimbs are solved to the stalk itself.

items.name: robot-horse
items.title: Robot horse
items.description: A quadruped whose gait is the mechanism: walk, trot, pace, canter and gallop are real footfall sequences whose beat is counted from them, and the load each grounded foot carries drives two joints nobody sets — a sprung fetlock that sinks under weight and recoils free, and a neck that nods because the forehand is loading and unloading. Drag across it to scrub the stride one footfall at a time.

items.name: robot-pegasus
items.title: Robot pegasus
items.description: A winged quadruped that hands its own weight across: lift is one number splitting the body between the legs and the wings, so the fetlocks recoil as they unload, the legs run out of reach and fold, the stride fades out and the wingbeat fades in. Each wing is three bones solved to a wingtip tracing a real figure of eight, so folding it is only the path closing.

items.name: robot-camel
items.title: Robot camel
items.description: The one machine here whose floor is not a line: its ground is a medium with a depth, and the feet go into it. The pad opens under load, that spread drops its pressure, and the pressure is what takes it into the sand — so an opening foot keeps the animal higher up. The hump is a store that slumps as it empties, and the roll is the gait: a pace throws the body right over and a trot barely moves it.

items.name: robot-turtle
items.title: Robot turtle
items.description: A plodder in plan view: the gait solver at four legs on a slow wave, a procedurally plated carapace, and one number that pulls the head, tail and every foot in underneath it.

items.name: robot-inchworm
items.title: Robot inchworm
items.description: A looper in side elevation that moves by alternating anchors rather than a travelling wave: the arch height is solved from the anchor span, so shortening the span raises the loop.

items.name: fabricator
items.title: Fabricator
items.description: An additive build cell that makes its own workpiece: a three-axis deposition head over a build plate, laying a sampled solid voxel by voxel, with a resolution axis that rebuilds the same object out of smaller cells and four camera angles.

items.name: voxel-form
items.title: Voxel form
items.description: The workpiece on its own: a continuous field sampled into vector voxels and laid cell by cell, with no machine around it — a resolution axis, a build line you can scrub, and four camera angles.

items.name: arm-fabricator
items.title: Arm fabricator
items.description: An articulated fabricator that reaches for the work: the turret yaws toward the cell being laid and the shoulder and elbow are solved with the analytic two-link elbow, laying the same sampled solid the gantry cell builds.

items.name: drone-fabricator
items.title: Drone fabricator
items.description: A free-flying fabricator with no envelope: a repulsor platform that flies to each cell, rides a fixed standoff above the build line, and banks into its own travel while it lays a sampled solid.

items.name: voxel-geometry
items.title: Voxel geometry
items.description: Continuous occupancy fields over the unit cube, sampled into buildable voxels: six shapes, a serpentine deposition order, surface extraction that drops every cell buried inside the solid, and the projected paths every fabricator draws them with.

items.name: spine-kinematics
items.title: Spine kinematics
items.description: A serpenoid travelling-wave body solver: joints, tangent angles, ground clearance, taper and steady turn, with every link the same length in every pose.

items.name: gait-kinematics
items.title: Gait kinematics
items.description: Equine footfall patterns as real sequences: touchdown instants per limb, a beat count derived from them rather than declared, the support pattern, a lead that mirrors the two sides, and the share of the standing weight each grounded foot is carrying.

items.name: hexapod-kinematics
items.title: Hexapod kinematics
items.description: A radial many-legged walker solver: four to ten legs, tripod, wave and ripple gaits, plan-view feet, and knees solved in each leg's own vertical plane.

items.name: linear-actuator
items.title: Linear actuator
items.description: A controlled linear cylinder with rod and piston travel, optional cutaway view, stroke ruler, and four paint variants. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: servo-motor
items.title: Servo motor
items.description: A positional servo motor with controlled horn angle, single, double, or cross horns, mounting tabs, and optional cable. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: rotary-table
items.title: Rotary table
items.description: A controlled rotary indexing table with equally spaced fixtures, optional workpieces, a fixed drive motor, and four paint variants. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: robot-rover
items.title: Robot rover
items.description: A top-down four- or six-wheel ground robot with controlled heading, front-wheel steering, tread travel, and a sensor turret. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: robot-drone
items.title: Robot drone
items.description: A four- or six-rotor drone drawn from four camera angles — plan, front, side and isometric — that flies its own path or takes a controlled heading, with spinning counter-rotating propellers, landing gear and optional guards.

items.name: lidar-scan
items.title: Lidar scan
items.description: A polar lidar display that plots supplied angle-distance samples, with sensor heading, scan ray, and range rings.

items.name: robot-gripper
items.title: Robot gripper
items.description: Standalone parallel or angular gripper with controlled jaw opening, status lamp, and four paint variants. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: conveyor-belt
items.title: Conveyor belt
items.description: Conveyor with automatic or controlled belt travel, reversible direction, rollers, and a configurable number of workpieces. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: planetary-gearbox
items.title: Planetary gearbox
items.description: A reduction stage with its face off: a sun driving three to five planets inside a held ring, with real meshing teeth and the ratio read off the tooth counts. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: belt-drive
items.title: Belt drive
items.description: A toothed belt between two pulleys with an adjustable idler, routed along its real tangents and wrap angles, with the teeth marching by arc length. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: cable-carrier
items.title: Cable carrier
items.description: The energy chain that feeds a moving axis: links placed by arc length along a fixed-length path whose fold travels at half the carriage. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: mecanum-wheel
items.title: Mecanum wheel
items.description: A holonomic wheel with six to fourteen barrel rollers modelled at 45 degrees out of the wheel plane, in left and right hands. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: tool-changer
items.title: Tool changer
items.description: A robot-side and tool-side coupler that comes apart: one engagement axis closes the gap, seats the halves, then drives the lock balls out into their groove. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: suction-gripper
items.title: Suction gripper
items.description: A bar of bellows cups that descends onto a sheet, compresses against it, and carries it on the lips while the line is live. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: robot-hand
items.title: Robot hand
items.description: A five-digit hand on a real saddle-jointed thumb: fingers that abduct about the palm normal, seven named grasps, a handedness, an articulated wrist, and the pad gap a pinch closes. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: hand-kinematics
items.title: Hand kinematics
items.description: A five-digit hand pose solver: three-link fingers abducted about the palm normal, a thumb on a real saddle joint, named grasps, and the pad gap a pinch actually closes.

items.name: robot-foot
items.title: Robot foot
items.description: An ankle and a hinged toe plate rolling through a stance: dorsiflexed at heel strike, flat at mid-stance, plantarflexed at push-off, with the load moving heel to ball to toe. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: robot-leg
items.title: Robot leg
items.description: A hip, knee and ankle solved to wherever the foot has to be, with strut actuators whose stroke is read off the pose. Grab it and the foot is yours. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: robot-torso
items.title: Robot torso
items.description: A pelvis, a column of equal vertebrae, and a cage of rib hoops that opens along the machine's depth as it breathes. Leaning and twisting move the shoulders without stretching the back. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: robot-skeleton
items.title: Robot skeleton
items.description: The whole biped, walking: solved legs on a rolling foot, an equal-segment spine under a rib cage, counter-swinging arms, and hands on the same solver the standalone hand ships. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: skeleton-kinematics
items.title: Skeleton kinematics
items.description: A biped pose solver: stride cycles with real duty factors, feet that roll heel to toe over a planted sole, an equal-segment spine, and arms swinging against the legs.

items.name: motion-platform
items.title: Motion platform
items.description: A six-degree-of-freedom Stewart base under a payload deck, with solved leg lengths, visible stroke, and a fault when a pose asks for more travel than it has. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: clamshell-laptop
items.title: Clamshell laptop
items.description: A portable workstation on one solved revolute hinge: the lid keeps its length at every angle, the screen is drawn only from a camera that can see it, and the hinge stops at the travel it has. Four camera angles, four displays.

items.name: slate-tablet
items.title: Slate tablet
items.description: A slate and the kickstand holding it up: one recline axis leans the slate and solves the stand's foot onto the desk, and a leg too short to reach folds flat instead of stretching. Docked stylus, four camera angles.

items.name: wheel-player
items.title: Wheel player
items.description: A pocket media player whose click wheel is geared to its list: one turn is one pass of the rows, the detents wrap in both directions, and the hold switch is a real interlock that takes the wheel away from pointer, key and behaviour alike.

items.name: slab-handset
items.title: Slab handset
items.description: A touchscreen handset modelled once and turned about its own axis: a quarter turn takes the screen edge on and a half turn shows the back and its camera array. Rolling it to landscape re-lays the display out rather than rotating a picture.

items.name: wrist-terminal
items.title: Wrist terminal
items.description: A wrist display on two solved mechanisms: a digital crown geared to the dial so the reading cannot disagree with the pointer, and a constant-pitch link band that keeps its length however far it is opened. Knurled ribs drawn only where they face you.

items.name: device-geometry
items.title: Device geometry
items.description: The mechanisms in a machine you carry: a hinge that keeps the lid's length, a kickstand whose foot has to reach the desk, rotary detents that wrap in both directions, a constant-pitch link band, and the projection that puts a screen on a plane at any attitude.

items.name: keyboard-geometry
items.title: Keyboard geometry
items.description: The mechanisms under a machine a person types on: key travel with real hysteresis, an asymmetric keystroke curve, unit-pitch deck layout with a stagger, sculpted row profiles, matrix scan order, typing schedules, and a raked deck frame that keycaps stand on as solids.

items.name: key-switch
items.title: Key switch
items.description: One mechanical keyswitch, sectioned: a stem on a coil spring whose contact closes partway down the travel rather than at the bottom, and opens again higher than it closed. Linear, tactile and clicky legs, and the travel is an axis you can set.

items.name: robot-keypad
items.title: Robot keypad
items.description: A raked bench entry pad on a scanned matrix: keys that stand on the face as solids and press along its normal, an entry readout that fills a digit at a time, and the cell the scan is reading drawn separately from the key that is down.

items.name: robot-keyboard
items.title: Robot keyboard
items.description: A whole key deck placed by a unit grid: rows specified in 1u, 1.25u and 6.25u widths on one pitch, sculpted caps that give the board a real profile in elevation, three layouts including a split deck whose halves are turned apart, and a matrix scan.

items.name: input-terminal
items.title: Input terminal
items.description: A bench console with two coupled mechanisms: a display head canted on a hinge up a column, and a key deck whose strokes are what put glyphs on the screen under a blinking block cursor.

items.name: transmission-geometry
items.title: Transmission geometry
items.description: Gear outlines and the phase that meshes them, assembly-valid planetary trains, the taut path of a belt round a set of pulleys, and an energy chain folded over its own bend.

items.name: robot-arm
items.title: Robot arm
items.description: An articulated industrial arm in SVG: any number of links, eight end effectors, four paint variants, four mounts, and pointer tracking. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: robot-arm-3d
items.title: Robot arm 3D
items.description: The articulated arm as a procedural react-three-fiber rig: no model to load, and it shares its palette with the SVG components.

items.name: robot-stage
items.title: Robot stage
items.description: The room the 3D robots stand in: a configured react-three-fiber canvas with lights, a contact shadow, a grid floor and orbit controls.

items.name: scara-arm
items.title: SCARA arm
items.description: A SCARA cell in plan view: two rotary links, a Z spindle, the swept area, and a shadow that reads as height. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: delta-arm
items.title: Delta arm
items.description: A parallel delta robot drawn in isometric, solved with real delta inverse kinematics rather than an approximation. Drawn from any of four camera angles, including its own free axonometric.

items.name: gantry-arm
items.title: Gantry arm
items.description: A cartesian gantry: independent axes, the dog-leg path a real machine takes, and an optional plotter trail. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: robot-face
items.title: Robot face
items.description: A head whose eyes follow the pointer anywhere on the page, with moods for waiting, succeeded, thinking, failed and asleep.

items.name: robot-loader
items.title: Robot loader
items.description: A pick-and-place cycle as a loading indicator: indeterminate on its own, or filling the out-tray in proportion to a value.

items.name: arm-controls
items.title: Arm controls
items.description: A teach pendant: one slider per joint driving an arm in forward kinematics, plus the tool selector and live readouts.

items.name: robot-kinematics
items.title: Robot kinematics
items.description: Dependency-free inverse and forward kinematics: analytic two-link elbow, FABRIK for longer chains, closed-form delta IK, isometric projection.

items.name: robot-style
items.title: Robot style
items.description: The shared visual language: size scale, paint variants, palette resolution from CSS variables, the capsule limb geometry every machine is drawn from, and the orthographic camera that projects one model into plan, elevation and isometric views.

items.name: robot-color
items.title: Robot color
items.description: Resolves CSS variables and oklch() to something three.js can parse, so the WebGL robots share the theme with the SVG ones.

items.name: use-robot-arm
items.title: useRobotArm
items.description: Animated pose for a link chain: eases the tool tip toward a target or a scripted path, and stops rendering entirely once the pose settles.

items.name: use-robot-motion
items.title: useRobotMotion
items.description: The clock every machine runs on and the handle you grab it by: a rate-limited scalar, pointer-capture dragging, and keyboard steps, all parked by a reduced-motion preference.

items.name: use-pointer-target
items.title: usePointerTarget
items.description: Pointer position mapped into a component's own world units, returning null when the pointer is away so a machine can fall back to its idle behaviour.

items.name: resolver
items.title: Resolver
items.description: A rotary transformer with a controlled primary rotor and ideal sine and cosine secondary channels, visible windings, and four projected camera views.

items.name: transformer-core
items.title: Transformer core
items.description: An EI or toroidal magnetic core with primary and secondary winding densities, reversible illustrative flux, selectable ratio, and four camera views.

items.name: magnetic-gripper
items.title: Magnetic gripper
items.description: A switchable electromagnetic gripper with exposed windings and pole shoes that captures and lifts a steel plate or bar in four camera views.

items.name: inductive-sensor
items.title: Inductive sensor
items.description: A threaded inductive proximity sensor with an exposed oscillator coil, movable metal target, qualitative sensing lobe, and four camera views.

items.name: eddy-current-brake
items.title: Eddy-current brake
items.description: A contactless brake whose magnet array overlaps a rotating conductive disc, revealing qualitative eddy paths, optional slots, and four camera views.

items.name: maglev-carriage
items.title: Maglev carriage
items.description: A levitated carriage travelling above a segmented linear stator with a constant visible air gap, selectable payloads, and four projected views.

items.name: voice-coil-actuator
items.title: Voice-coil actuator
items.description: A bidirectional moving-coil actuator travelling through a fixed annular magnet gap, with a visible carriage, qualitative field, and four camera views.

items.name: magnetic-bearing
items.title: Magnetic bearing
items.description: A contactless bearing with four opposed electromagnets centering a visibly unsupported rotor along either controlled axis in four camera views.

items.name: induction-motor
items.title: Induction motor
items.description: A cutaway induction motor with a balanced three-phase stator, squirrel-cage rotor, configurable poles, visible slip, and four projected camera views.

items.name: stepper-motor
items.title: Stepper motor
items.description: An open stepper motor with four phase windings, a toothed permanent-magnet rotor, discrete indexed motion, detents, and four camera views.

items.name: solenoid-valve
items.title: Solenoid valve
items.description: A coil-driven plunger switching a two- or three-port valve gallery, with a visible return spring, flow route, and four projected camera views.

items.name: electromagnetic-relay
items.title: Electromagnetic relay
items.description: An exposed relay whose energized coil pulls a hinged armature across one or two normally-open or normally-closed contact sets in four camera views.

items.name: electromagnetism-geometry
items.title: Electromagnetism geometry
items.description: Dependency-free winding geometry, balanced three-phase field vectors, and ideal resolver sine and cosine channels for electromagnetic machines.

items.name: produce-geometry
items.title: Produce geometry
items.description: Dependency-free solids of revolution: a surface from a profile, a golden-angle lattice spaced by equal surface area, half shells that reassemble, a hinge about any line, and blades that keep their length at every pitch.

items.name: robot-avocado
items.title: Robot avocado
items.description: A split-shell specimen pod: one solid of revolution halved on its own centre plane, the two halves tilting apart on a rod under the machine while the stone rides up out of the gap on a screw column. Four camera angles, and a drag to part it.

items.name: robot-strawberry
items.title: Robot strawberry
items.description: A berry-shelled field unit whose sensor studs are placed by the golden angle over equal areas of its own skin and run out along their own surface normals, under a calyx of rigid blades on one hinge. Four camera angles, and a drag to work the collar.

items.name: robot-tomato
items.title: Robot tomato
items.description: A truss-hung crop unit: a clamp, a peduncle with two hinges sharing one swing angle, a lobed shell, and a ripening front that is real coverage of the surface rather than a colour ramp. Four camera angles, and a drag to swing it.

items.name: phyllotaxis-geometry
items.title: Phyllotaxis geometry
items.description: Dependency-free golden-angle disc lattices with the Fibonacci spiral arms that fall out of them, a dished face and its normals, a two-axis aim solved from a direction, and rigid hinged ray florets.

items.name: robot-sunflower
items.title: Robot sunflower
items.description: A heliotropic collector mast: a golden-angle floret lattice on a dished head, aimed at the light by a two-axis tracker, on a stem that leans toward it while the gimbal collar takes up the remainder.

items.name: sound-geometry
items.title: Sound geometry
items.description: The closures in a machine that makes a sound by moving something: a spiral groove geared to its platter, a pivoted tonearm solved from the groove radius with its tracking error, an exponential horn, a spring governor, a comb tuned by length, and a pinned barrel that is also a step sequencer.

items.name: piano-geometry
items.title: Piano geometry
items.description: The closures in a grand: an action whose ratio is a product of three levers and whose jack lets the hammer go before the blow, a back check, a damper that leaves the string late, a scale that cannot be ideal, a bridge and bent side that are the envelope of it, and a lid solved from its prop stick.

items.name: turntable-deck
items.title: Turntable deck
items.description: A belt-drive deck whose arm is geared to its platter by the groove: one revolution walks the stylus in by exactly one groove pitch, the arm angle is solved from the radius, and the tracking error is in the readout. Drag the platter and it scrubs.

items.name: gramophone-horn
items.title: Gramophone horn
items.description: An acoustic deck on a mainspring: a governor holds the platter at its rate until the spring runs down and then lets it sag, the crank is the wind, and the horn is an exponential flare modelled once and projected from every camera.

items.name: music-box-drum
items.title: Music box drum
items.description: A pinned barrel plucking a comb tuned by length: the notes are a pattern you pass it, a pin bends its tine further and further and lets go the instant it reaches the tip, and an air brake fly regulates the turn.

items.name: robot-grand-piano
items.title: Robot grand piano
items.description: A player grand whose roll drives 88 solved actions: the jack lets each hammer go before it reaches the string, the back check catches it coming down, the dampers leave late, the pedals work, and the bent side of the case is the envelope of the string scale.

items.name: busker-droid
items.title: Busker droid
items.description: A one-machine band whose pose comes from data: a step pattern raises each beater as its step comes round and drops it on the beat, and both arms are two-link solutions to the thing they are about to hit.

items.name: celestial-geometry
items.title: Celestial geometry
items.description: Dependency-free orbital mechanics: Kepler's equation solved to machine precision, elliptical orbits about a focus, the terminator great circle, phase and per-point illumination, limb darkening, body frames, and a deterministic irregular radius field.

items.name: celestial-planet
items.title: Celestial planet
items.description: A tilted, turning globe with latitude bands, polar caps, longitude storms and a ring system the body genuinely occludes — the far arc is cut where the silhouette crosses it, and the day-night line is a projected great circle.

items.name: celestial-moon
items.title: Celestial moon
items.description: The phase machine: a lunation whose crescent is the projection of the terminator circle rather than a drawn shape, with libration rocking the body so the limb craters come round and go again.

items.name: celestial-star
items.title: Celestial star
items.description: A luminous body drawn from the limb-darkening law rather than a gradient, with granulation, a rotating spot belt, prominence loops anchored on the limb, and a corona. Three classes change the coefficient.

items.name: celestial-asteroid
items.title: Celestial asteroid
items.description: An irregular body whose radius is a deterministic sum of cosine lobes, so its silhouette genuinely changes as it turns — and it tumbles about an axis that is itself going round.

items.name: orrery
items.title: Orrery
items.description: A geared model of a system: bodies carried on radial arms whose length is the orbital radius, running fast at periapsis and slow at apoapsis on real Kepler ellipses with the hub at a focus.

items.name: hull-geometry
items.title: Hull geometry
items.description: Dependency-free geometry for a plated body that comes apart: an equal-area tiling of a sphere into armour plates whose areas sum to exactly one, a fracture front and the straight-line travel behind it, a shock ring as a real circle in a stated plane, and a paraboloid dish that focuses because of its shape.

items.name: battle-station
items.title: Battle station
items.description: An armoured orbital battle station whose hull is a real tiling: breakup launches every plate down its own straight line behind a fracture front, and putting it back reassembles the sphere exactly. Carries a girdle trench, a plating axis and a paraboloid focusing dish.

items.name: debris-field
items.title: Debris field
items.description: What is left of a plated body: a population of hull fragments on straight trajectories from one rupture, each released at its own moment and turning at its own rate, drawn back to front so a near fragment genuinely occludes a far one.

items.name: linkage-geometry
items.title: Linkage geometry
items.description: Dependency-free closed-loop kinematics: a four-bar solved as a circle intersection with a chosen branch, a slider-crank with an analytic stroke, block-and-tackle travel from rope length, and the helpers that lift an elevation drawing into world space.

items.name: pumpjack
items.title: Pumpjack
items.description: A beam pump solved as the four-bar it is: crank, pitman and walking beam close a real loop, and the polished-rod stroke falls out of the link lengths rather than being tweened. Crank, beam or air balance, and four camera views.

items.name: drilling-derrick
items.title: Drilling derrick
items.description: A mast, a crown block and a travelling block reeved on four to twelve lines, where the drum's payout is shared between the lines so mechanical advantage is visible as rope. Racked pipe, a drawworks drum that turns, and a mud return.

items.name: mud-pump
items.title: Mud pump
items.description: A simplex, duplex or triplex reciprocating pump whose cylinders are separate slider-cranks a third of a revolution apart, with a discharge readout summed from the solved piston velocities rather than drawn as a constant.

items.name: wellhead-tree
items.title: Wellhead tree
items.description: The pressure-control stack on a completed well: a master, a swab and two wing valves whose rising stems show their state, an adjustable choke, and an accent that follows only the bore the open valves actually leave through.

items.name: storage-tank
items.title: Storage tank
items.description: A crude tank whose external floating roof rides the liquid, with a rolling ladder solved from wherever the roof is, a spiral stairway on the shell, course seams and a wind girder, or a fixed cone roof instead.

items.name: oil-tanker
items.title: Oil tanker
items.description: A crude carrier whose cargo sets her draft, so the boot top, the draft marks and the load line go under while the sea line stays put. Midship manifold, deck hatches, accommodation and funnel, and a gentle swell.

items.name: tanker-truck
items.title: Tanker truck
items.description: A tractor and a bulkheaded road tanker on one kingpin, where the hitch is a real yaw in world space: the barrel foreshortens in side elevation as it turns and swings properly in plan. Compartments discharge from the rear.

items.name: flare-stack
items.title: Flare stack
items.description: A derrick-supported flare with a knockout drum, a tip, a steam ring and lit pilots, and a plume whose length comes from the flow and whose lean comes from the wind. The plume is drawn, and the docs say so.

items.name: fractionating-column
items.title: Fractionating column
items.description: A crude distillation tower whose tray count is the axis: the spacing, the weld-ring seams and the heights the side draws come off are all derived from it. Four named cuts, a movable flash zone, overhead drum and reboiler.

items.name: jackup-rig
items.title: Jack-up rig
items.description: An offshore jack-up on three or four fixed-length truss legs, where one number is both the air gap above the water and the leg left sticking up above the deck. Spudcans on the seabed, a helideck and a cantilevered derrick.

items.name: hopper-dynamics
items.title: Hopper dynamics
items.description: Bounce dynamics for machines that leave the ground: an exact ballistic flight, an exact spring-mass stance, contact and flight times derived from the drop height and spring rate, a decaying drop that comes to rest, plus a coil helix that cannot pass its solid height and a constant-volume shell squash.

items.name: spring-hopper
items.title: Spring hopper
items.description: A single-legged hopping rig whose helical spring really compresses: the stance and the flight are solved from the drop height and the spring rate, the coil count never changes, and it cannot be crushed past its own solid height. Drag it down to load it and let go.

items.name: ball-hopper
items.title: Ball hopper
items.description: A bounding sensor ball whose shell is its own compliance: it flattens on impact at constant volume, so it has to get exactly that much wider, and dropped with a restitution below one it bounces lower each time and comes to rest. Drawn from any of four camera angles.

items.name: vehicle-geometry
items.title: Vehicle geometry
items.description: Ackermann steering, steady-state articulation, coordinated bank, a rigid body sitting on N axles, the rocket equation and surface-piercing foil lift — the constraints a vehicle works against.

items.name: robot-car
items.title: Robot car
items.description: An autonomous road car whose two front wheels are solved from one steering angle by true Ackermann geometry, with body roll from the turn radius and a body that rides the road on its axles.

items.name: transit-bus
items.title: Transit bus
items.description: An articulated city bus whose rear section angle is solved from the tractor turn, with plug doors, a concertina at the joint and a kneel that rides on the doors own number.

items.name: cargo-plane
items.title: Cargo plane
items.description: A high-wing freighter that banks because it was asked to turn: the angle comes from airspeed and rate of turn, and the ailerons carry the roll the autopilot has not finished.

items.name: hydrofoil-craft
items.title: Hydrofoil craft
items.description: A foilborne ferry that climbs out of its own ground plane: lift goes as the square of speed, so the surface-piercing V sheds immersed area and the hull rises clear of the water.

items.name: launch-vehicle
items.title: Launch vehicle
items.description: A two-stage orbital booster that flies a pitch program, gimbals its engine cluster against it, stages, and reports the ideal delta-v left from the rocket equation.

items.name: strike-starfighter
items.title: Strike starfighter
items.description: A split-foil attack fighter: four wings on two fore-aft hinges that open from a cruise plane into an X, carrying their own engines and tip cannons with them.

items.name: ion-interceptor
items.title: Ion interceptor
items.description: A twin ion-drive interceptor: hexagonal panels pitching on lateral pylons around a pod that yaws inside them, carrying its viewport and emitters round with it.

items.name: household-geometry
items.title: Household geometry
items.description: The closures in the building you live in and the machines inside it: a leaf hinged on an edge that keeps its width, sectional panels that keep their length round a bend, a drum whose whole regime is one Froude number, a tub on a resonant suspension, a lift car roped to a counterweight, tracking slats that report their stops, and Darcy flow through a packed bed.

items.name: gabled-house
items.title: Gabled house
items.description: A dwelling drawn as a machine: the ridge height is the roof pitch you pass it, the garage door's rigid panels ride one track from vertical to horizontal, and the louvre fins and the garden array turn to face a sun that is one number — the time of day.

items.name: tower-block
items.title: Tower block
items.description: A residential tower with the lift left visible: the storey count sets the height, the facade grid and the travel, and the car and counterweight hang on one rope over one sheave, so the weight falls exactly as far as the car rises.

items.name: espresso-machine
items.title: Espresso machine
items.description: A spring-lever group drawn as the linkage it is: the lever is a crank, the link a connecting rod and the piston a slider, so the declining shot pressure is the spring paying its force back rather than a curve somebody drew.

items.name: refrigerator
items.title: Refrigerator
items.description: A cabinet whose doors are solved leaves on vertical hinges, with an interior that is a second drawing revealed by the swing and a lamp thrown by a real door switch. Top-freezer, side-by-side or single.

items.name: washing-machine
items.title: Washing machine
items.description: One drum, and one dimensionless number deciding what it is doing: below a Froude number of one the load is thrown and falls on a real ballistic arc, at or above it the load is pinned to the wall. The tub answers an out-of-balance load through its own resonance.

items.name: rail-geometry
items.title: Rail geometry
items.description: What a track does to the vehicle standing on it: bogies placed on a curve with the centre and end throw that follow, Klingel hunting on a coned wheelset, a pantograph solved to a working height, and turnout lead geometry with blade throw and detection.

items.name: rail-locomotive
items.title: Rail locomotive
items.description: An electric locomotive and its train, placed by the track rather than steered along it: each bogie takes the tangent under its own pivot, each body is the chord between two of them, and the centre and end throw fall out of that.

items.name: rail-bogie
items.title: Rail bogie
items.description: A powered two-axle bogie whose wheelsets hunt because they are coned, at exactly Klingel wavelength, with a frame that is not animated but placed by the two wheelsets it joins.

items.name: pantograph-collector
items.title: Pantograph collector
items.description: A single-arm roof current collector that spends reach to buy height, with a control rod loop that keeps the head level over its working range and a contact wire strung with real stagger.

items.name: rail-turnout
items.title: Rail turnout
items.description: A trailing-point turnout on a point machine: two blades on one throw bar, a route that is detection rather than a setting, and a crossing angle that is the turnout number and nothing else.
